text: BJL HP Corp. (the "Applicant") is the owner of the properties municipally known as 2-6 Howard Park Avenue (the "Subject Property"). On April 21, 2021, the Applicant applied for Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments in order to facilitate a proposed redevelopment of the Subject Property (the "Applications"). The Applications proposed an 11-storey mixed use building with 128 residential units and 377 square metres of commercial retail space at grade. The proposed overall height of the building is 39.95 metres, inclusive of the mechanical penthouse, and the proposed floor space index is 7.93 times the area of the lot. The Application would require the demolition of the 1-storey Master Mechanic automobile service and repair shop.
